name: Nori
long_description:
Nori is a concierge-level AI health coach in your pocket. 

It takes all of your health data—Apple Health, medical records, wearables, everything—and boils it down into a personalized daily plan.

Users love it: “It's truly one of the best apps and I check it first every day. Since using Nori, I've been limiting devices in bed and eating earlier—and I'll be damned if it's not working... I started getting more deep sleep, my resting HR dropped to 43, my recovery improved.”—Jen, Nori user"
one_liner: AI health coach in your pocket

launches.title: Nori: Personal health coach in your pocket
launches.tagline: Connect your wearables, labs, and health apps directly to AI—get personalized insights every day
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94783&key=user_uploads/156882/2070df36-afa6-4a71-87e7-1398758caed3)

**I wrecked my body** over six years building my last startup, then spent six months obsessively fixing it… juggling five different apps, spreadsheets, counting every calorie.

Two weeks into my new company, I could feel it happening again. Staying healthy was becoming a second full-time job. 

**That’s why we built Nori.**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kUbvmqdwqSA

\
**What it is:** All your health data in one place—Apple Health, Oura, Whoop, Peloton, nutrition apps, Garmin, MyChart, blood tests from Function Health, Superpower—all feeding your personal health AI.

**Who it’s for:** People who want weight loss, better energy, or faster recovery—starting with iOS users

**Real examples from my own data:**

* I got stronger when I added rest days instead of grinding 6-7 workouts weekly
* Magnesium at bedtime increased my REM sleep by 25%
* When I miss a workout, Nori tells me exactly how to adjust

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94783&key=user_uploads/156882/90c3d465-cd9c-4aaa-b378-cf827d3d5ae3)

**About us**\
We’re [Dave](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dzohrob/) and [Harish](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harish-p-agarwal/), cofounders of **Chartable** (acquired by Spotify in 2022); Harish was co-founder/CTO of **Octopart** (YC W07, acquired 2015).

**Try it now**\
Have a wearable + iPhone and actually want to get healthier? [Give us a try](https://nori.ai)—use invite code LAUNCHYC.

We’re especially looking for Apple Watch users focused on weight loss or energy.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94783&key=user_uploads/156882/75767d90-b59d-4635-98aa-e675041e4c1a)
